programme.title: Myna
programme.desc: Born into a humble & rustic background troubled by familial & financial concerns, Myna takes it upon herself to leave home & fearlessly pursue a better life for her family. Watch her bravely face the odds of life with unwavering spirit.

programme.title: Sindhu Bhairavi
programme.desc: Sindhu loves her sister like a second mother & believes compassion outweighs all riches. But, Vasundhara, a woman of pride & privilege, worships money & social status. When their worlds collide, what trials will Sindhu face in her fight for justice?

programme.title: Gelathi Gayathri
programme.desc: Best friends and confidantes, Parvathi and Gayatri reunite after years. Unaware of a buried love from Gayatri’s past, Parvathi sets out to find her a match. But when an accident leaves her in a coma, fate sets the stage for a life-altering twist.

programme.title: Mangalyaa
programme.desc: For Mayuri, family always comes first. For Tarak, bitterness towards his mother fuels every step. As their paths cross, love and revenge blur - witness the fate that binds Mayuri & Tarak together.

programme.title: Mooguthi Malli
programme.desc: Viraj, heir to the Aru Masala spice empire, falls for Malli, a simple yet gifted cook. But as their bond deepens into a silent battle of passion, hidden vengeance surfaces. Caught in a web of secrets, can their love survive?

programme.title: Shanthi Nivasa
programme.desc: Shanthi Nivasa

programme.title: Mangalyaa
programme.desc: For Mayuri, family always comes first. For Tarak, bitterness towards his mother fuels every step. As their paths cross, love and revenge blur - witness the fate that binds Mayuri & Tarak together.

programme.title: Krishna Vamshi
programme.desc: All her life, Vamshika has yearned for the warmth of a big, close-knit family. When she finally steps into her husband’s bustling household, she must brave trials and traditions to win every heart and turn obstacles into affection.

programme.title: Myna
programme.desc: Born into a humble & rustic background troubled by familial & financial concerns, Myna takes it upon herself to leave home & fearlessly pursue a better life for her family. Watch her bravely face the odds of life with unwavering spirit.

programme.title: Sindhu Bhairavi
programme.desc: Sindhu loves her sister like a second mother & believes compassion outweighs all riches. But, Vasundhara, a woman of pride & privilege, worships money & social status. When their worlds collide, what trials will Sindhu face in her fight for justice?

programme.title: Gelathi Gayathri
programme.desc: Best friends and confidantes, Parvathi and Gayatri reunite after years. Unaware of a buried love from Gayatri’s past, Parvathi sets out to find her a match. But when an accident leaves her in a coma, fate sets the stage for a life-altering twist.
